ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Child Care System
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and connections between non-profits and government agencies in Minnesota's child care system
ideas.angle: Financial analysis and connections between entities
questions: What are the financial transactions between non-profits and government agencies?
Are there any shell companies involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme in Minnesota's child care system. By following the money and analyzing financial transactions, we may be able to identify shell companies and connections between non-profits and government agencies.
